items.description: Landlord may elect, by written notice to Tenant, to cancel and terminate the Lease (or the affected portion) after receiving Transfer information, except for a Permitted Transfer.
items.span_text: Landlord shall have the right (but not the obligation), exercisable by written notice to Tenant, to elect to cancel and terminate this Lease
items.trigger: Except with regard to a Permitted Transfer, at any time within twenty (20) business days after Landlord’s receipt of all (but not less than all) of the information and documents described in Section 10.2

items.description: Tenant must pay Landlord, as Additional Rent, a share of any Excess Rent immediately upon receiving it when it assigns the Lease or subleases part of the Tenant Space.
items.span_text: then Tenant shall pay to Landlord, as Additional Rent, fifty percent (50%) of any such Excess Rent immediately upon Tenant’s receipt thereof.
items.trigger: if Tenant assigns this Lease, or subleases any part of the Tenant Space, for any Excess Rent

items.description: Tenant must deliver a signed estoppel certificate covering matters reasonably requested by Landlord, a prospective purchaser or a Holder within the stated period after Landlord's written request.
items.span_text: within ten (10) business days after written request by Landlord, Tenant shall execute, acknowledge and deliver to Landlord a statement in writing certifying all matters reasonably requested by Landlord and/or any prospective purchaser of the Building and/or the Property and/or any Holder.
items.trigger: within ten (10) business days after written request by Landlord

items.description: Landlord must deliver a signed estoppel certificate covering matters reasonably requested by Tenant within the stated period after Tenant's written request.
items.span_text: within ten (10) days after written request by Tenant, Landlord shall execute, acknowledge and deliver to Tenant a statement in writing certifying all matters reasonably requested by Tenant
items.trigger: At any time and from time to time, within ten (10) days after written request by Tenant

items.description: Tenant must sign and return additional documents evidencing subordination of the Lease and its agreement to attorn, in the form reasonably required by Landlord or a Holder.
items.span_text: Tenant covenants and agrees to execute and deliver, within ten (10) business days after receipt thereof, and in the form reasonably required by Landlord or any Holder, any additional documents evidencing the priority or subordination of this Lease and Tenant’s agreement to attorn with respect to any such Security Document

items.description: Tenant must send each Noticed Holder, by registered or certified mail, a copy of any default notice it serves on Landlord.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees to give each Noticed Holder, by registered or certified mail, a copy of any notice of default served upon the Landlord by Tenant.
